notable_absence.finding: The Cleanup section explicitly states the new dynamic cleanup-set behavior is designed so 'users without complex requirements should never need to think about or configure transaction cleanup' - i.e. the opposite of requiresExplicitCleanupOnFailure. No relation was forced for this since it is an absence-of-requirement claim, not a positive fact the predicate can express without inverting its own meaning; captured instead as prose here.
